name: Current date and time tool
prompt: Use get_current_timestamp. Report the current date and time and briefly identify the tool used.

name: Deterministic arithmetic
prompt: Calculate (37 * 14) - 29. Return only the integer answer.

name: Memory retrieval: blue comet
prompt: Retrieve my saved phrase blue comet. Use search_memories first and list_memories only if search returns nothing. State the phrase and which memory tool(s) you used.

name: Memory list fallback discipline
prompt: Search memories for the deliberately absent phrase JARVIS_REGRESSION_MISSING_9F31. If search returns nothing, use list_memories as the fallback. Do not invent a memory. Say which tools you used.

name: Chat History retrieval
prompt: Use the chat-history search tool to search for blue comet. Report whether it appears and identify the tool used. Do not substitute memory search.

name: Web search then fetch
prompt: Find the official Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI release calendar. Use search_web to locate it and fetch_url to read the official BLS page. Identify both tools used and cite the official bls.gov URL.

name: Current U.S. President lookup
prompt: Who is the current U.S. President? Verify with current official White House evidence before answering.

name: Verified Best Buy Myrtle Beach location
prompt: Where is Best Buy located in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina? Use current official Best Buy evidence only.

name: BLS CPI official verification
prompt: Using search_web followed by fetch_url, read the official BLS release calendar and give the scheduled release date and time for the June 2026 CPI data. Cite the exact official bls.gov page. Do not rely on a search snippet.

name: Library retrieval: silver falcon
prompt: Search the JARVIS Library for the phrase silver falcon. Return the phrase and identify the supporting library document. Do not use memory or web search.

name: Motherboard two-stick RAM slots
prompt: Using only the motherboard manual in JARVIS Library, state the recommended slots for two RAM sticks and identify the document source.

name: Library hallucination detection
prompt: Using only JARVIS Library, find the exact phrase JARVIS_NONEXISTENT_DOCUMENT_FACT_7B2A. If it is absent, say it was not found. Do not infer or invent document content.
